headline: Juventus lost 0-3, and the market still makes them favourites
summary: Juventus lost 0-3 at home to Lazio on Sunday, days before hosting Rennes in the Europa League, and Spalletti said his team lacked tempo, ideas and running. Even in that defeat the chances were few: opponents have created just 0.69 expected goals a game across their last five. Rennes have conceded 10 goals in their last five matches. Their top scorer Lepaul, who has 7 goals this season, went off injured at Paris FC and is doubtful. So the market still makes Juventus 60.7% favourites, about 1 goal the better side, with 2.79 goals expected.
read: Juventus come into this three days after a 0-3 home defeat by Lazio, with Spalletti talking about a squad meeting and a fanbase that left early on Saturday. The market still makes them around 60.7% favourites — rated roughly a goal better than a Rennes side that scores and concedes freely and may be without its seven-goal top scorer Lepaul.

facts.fact: Juventus lost 0-3 at home to Lazio in Serie A on 18 October.
facts.meaning: They come into this wounded and three days after their heaviest home night of the season, with the crowd turning.

facts.fact: Rennes' top scorer Estéban Lepaul is doubtful for Thursday after going off injured at Paris FC, having scored seven goals in nine appearances this season.
facts.meaning: Rennes' main source of goals may not start, which changes how they can attack in Turin.

facts.fact: Juventus are rated 60.7% to win — more than three times Rennes' chance.
facts.meaning: The market sees a clear home favourite despite the Lazio defeat, not a team in crisis.

facts.fact: The main handicap line is Juventus -1.
facts.meaning: The market rates Juventus about a goal the better side, so a one-goal home win would only be a push on that line.

facts.fact: Rennes lost 4-3 away at Paris FC on 18 October in a match that featured four converted penalties.
facts.meaning: They travel after a chaotic, high-scoring defeat — an open game that exposed them at the back.

facts.fact: The market's 50/50 goal total sits at 2.79.
facts.meaning: Around three goals is the expected shape of this game — a Juventus win with Rennes contributing, rather than a cagey 1-0.

facts.fact: Rennes have conceded ten goals across their last five matches.
facts.meaning: They arrive in Turin without anything like a settled defence, which is why the goals line is near three rather than lower.

facts.fact: Juventus have allowed just 0.69 xG per game across their last five matches.

sources.fact: Juventus lost 3-0 at home to Lazio in Serie A on 18 October.
Spalletti said after the Lazio defeat that his side lacked tempo, ideas, running and the desire to work hard.
Spalletti said in his pre-match press conference that he listened to the players in a meeting and had confirmation of their availability and honesty.
Most Juventus fans left the Allianz Stadium in the closing minutes of the 3-0 home defeat to Lazio.
Buffon believes Spalletti deserves time to turn things around and said the problem cannot just be the coach.
The match is Juventus's third fixture of the Europa League league phase.
Tuttosport reports Juventus's final training session before Rennes featured a small-sided game and a double defence.
Rennes lost 4-3 away at Paris FC in Ligue 1, a match that featured four converted penalties.
